name: Alessandro Bellini
bio:
Alessandro's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. This sparked an insatiable curiosity for aerodynamics, leading him to pursue a degree in Aerospace Engineering at the Politecnico di Milano. His thesis on advanced wing designs caught the attention of a small Italian racing team, where he spent two years honing his skills and contributing to significant performance gains. 

Alessandro is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of aerodynamic innovation. He believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing wind tunnel results and CFD simulations to optimize car performance. He is known for his ability to think outside the box and come up with unconventional solutions that often surprise his colleagues. His loyalty to his team and dedication to excellence make him a valuable asset.

At 25, Alessandro brings a fresh perspective and unwavering commitment to the team. He is determined to help the team reach new heights through cutting-edge aerodynamic design and a collaborative spirit.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight wave.
physical.description: Alessandro is of average height, with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and equations.
Has a habit of drumming his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on playing classical music in his office to stimulate creativity.
